Laura / team —

Inventory check summary: as of this morning we have sufficient capacity in us-west to support an 8-card dedicated pool through July. However, there are pending commitments expected to convert in the next 10–20 days (two large mid-market deals). To balance risk, ops proposes the following provisional hold policy for late-stage deals:

- Provisional hold window: up to 14 days (extendable once by 7 days with approval).
- Hold effect: reserve the requested GPU cards from allocation pools; no customer billing until SOW/IO signature.
- Soft precommit option: customer can opt into a 25% provisional fee to lock the hold for 30 days (non-refundable credit toward first invoice).
- Auto-release: if not executed within hold window, reservation released and customer notified; ops will provide a 48-hour final notice.

We can create a hold ticket (CAP-4123) and mark the pool as provisional. We'll also timestamp the reservation and attach a short acknowledgment PDF for procurement.

Next steps for sales: confirm whether Mirage chooses soft precommit or standard provisional hold and feed me the target start date.

Karthik Iyer
Capacity & Fleet Planning | Redwood Inference
